test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 08 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
A, B, C, D, W, X and Y are sitting around a circular table facing the centre of the table.

A sits fourth to the left of Y. W sits fourth to the right of C. Only two people sit between Y and C when counted from the left of Y. X is not an immediate neighbour of W or Y. D is not an immediate neighbour of X. Who sits third to the right of B?
solution:
**Given:** A, B, C, D, W, X and Y are sitting around a circular table facing the centre of the table.

1. A sits fourth to the left of Y.

2. Only two people sit between Y and C when counted from the left of Y. 

3. W sits fourth to the right of C.

4. X is not an immediate neighbour of W or Y.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/487a726ec1d215e7819931b4bce51830116487f36ce92ea3ca13d2ff89cae8eb.png] 

5. D is not an immediate neighbour of X.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/04f5043532b9dd6d5f6b0638e17e1c06c98cd5316709e57b053392dd9feea146.png] 

 

B, the only person left will occupy the vacant position.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7c302c5d2f471a063b88eab3cf8b396d0d148eb13e891c1818adc284e7b1fe99.png] 

Thus, D sits third to the right of B.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
